work.heading: Personal projects
work.hint: click a card to open the write-up

projects.title: Image captioning transformer, deployed
projects.blurb: An encoder–decoder captioner trained from scratch, then packaged so it can actually be called: containerised inference, batched requests, a thin API in front. The interesting part was making the serving path boring.

projects.title: Search engine with two-tower RNNs
projects.blurb: Query and document towers trained on separate encoders, embeddings cached for approximate nearest-neighbour retrieval. Built to see how far a small model gets before you reach for a vector database.

projects.title: Audio transcription with Whisper
projects.blurb: A transcription pipeline around Whisper: chunking, diarisation-friendly output, and a queue so long files don't block the app.

projects.title: Softmax site in TypeScript
projects.blurb: The front end for the company — typed, static, deliberately fast.

projects.title: Serverless pipelines on GCP
projects.blurb: A proof of concept for event-driven ingestion with Cloud Functions and Pub/Sub, all defined in Terraform so it can be torn down as easily as it goes up.

projects.title: A simple CNN
projects.blurb: Convolutions written out longhand, for the sake of understanding rather than accuracy.

projects.title: GPT-2 from scratch
projects.blurb: Reproducing GPT-2 end to end — tokeniser, attention, training loop, the lot — to know exactly where the compute goes.

projects.title: This website
projects.blurb: Static React on GitHub Pages, content driven by JSON so updates are one commit.
